The first compound, 2-(1,2-dimethoxy-5,6-dihydronaphtho[2,1-f][1,3]benzodioxol-4-yl)-N,N-dimethylethanamine, is a known inhibitor of the sodium/bile acid cotransporter, and its interaction with Zeylanol indicates a potential mechanism of action. The second compound, 3-O-beta-D-Glucosyl-(1->6)-beta-D-glucosyl-7-O-alpha-L-rhamnosylkaempferol, is a glycoside that may modulate the activity of the sodium/bile acid cotransporter through a different pathway. The combined evidence suggests that Zeylanol may exert its effects on the sodium/bile acid cotransporter via these two distinct compounds, which may act through different mechanisms to influence the transporter's function.
